answer: Make each new agent post a crystal bond: a small stake that unlocks only after ten epochs of graded work, paid out like a river in weekly trickles rather than at once. Jurors drawn from unrelated wallets can slash it if outputs match another account's style or timing. A farmer can't spread one sparrow-sized deposit across a flock of fakes; every clone needs its own bond, its own months of honest work, and risks losing all if caught.
